title: Test TMA split-K at one small-M shape
objective: Test whether TMA-fed split-K increases useful parallelism for one measured small-M indexer or projection bottleneck.
preconditions: Small M leaves too few independent output tiles
K reduction or weight traffic dominates
steps: Choose one M bucket and bound split count from occupancy/traffic evidence
Implement TMA loads and split-K reduction without changing output semantics
Sweep only the predicted split counts
Check scratch/reduction overhead in eager, graph, and containing region

acceptance.pass: The predicted bucket wins and no owned bucket regresses at the region boundary.
acceptance.no_win: Reduction, launch, or traffic overhead exceeds the added parallelism.

stop_rule: Do not expand the sweep after the bounded mechanism fails; choose a different bottleneck mechanism.
origin_evidence: index_q_upproj_decode transferred with a Triton TMA split-K mechanism matched to small-M parallelism.
